name: RabbitMQ
description: Bounded native AMQP 0-9-1 publishing, basic.get settlement and queue/exchange operations.

permissions.description: Native TCP/TLS AMQP to an explicit host with named password/CA secrets or selected profile credentials. Filesystem is conservatively declared because the shared textual scanner matches AMQP connection.open(); the audited bundle has no fs import or file API. No ambient configuration, file certificates or credentials.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Connection Check (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Connection Check. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Check Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Check Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Declare Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Declare Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Delete Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Purge Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Purge Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Bind Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Bind Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Unbind Queue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Unbind Queue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Check Exchange (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Check Exchange. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Declare Exchange (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Declare Exchange. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Delete Exchange (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Exchange. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Bind Exchange (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Bind Exchange. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Unbind Exchange (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Unbind Exchange. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Publish Text (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Publish Text. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Publish Json (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Publish Json. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Publish Binary (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Publish Binary. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Get and Acknowledge (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get and Acknowledge. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Get and Requeue (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get and Requeue. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Get and Reject (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get and Reject. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Get and Nack (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get and Nack. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Get Batch and Acknowledge (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Batch and Acknowledge. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Text to Payload (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Text to Payload. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Payload to Text (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Payload to Text. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ JSON to Payload (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
JSON to Payload. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Payload to JSON (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Payload to JSON. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Validate Properties (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Validate Properties. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Validate Headers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Validate Headers. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: RabbitMQ Validate Uint64 (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Validate Uint64. Native AMQP 0-9-1 via embedded amqplib@2.2.0 with retained precision patches; ordinary licensed driver 109822 bytes. Each network invocation opens/closes a fresh connection and one channel. TLS verifies CA and hostname by default; explicit tlsMode=disable is plaintext. Named RuntimeConnection config/credentials or named RABBITMQ_PASSWORD secret. Every mutation requires request.confirm=true and numeric $retries=0 (or absent) in node and raw profile config. No automatic retry, unknown outcome replay, persistent consumer, cross-node delivery tags or HTTP bridge. Total deadline includes profile/secret/import/wire/final decode/close, up to 1 MiB total wire, 65536-byte messages, 65536-byte frames, 2048 frames and 100 messages. Returned messages are visible; confirmed does not mean routed or processed. basic.get settlement is performed within its original channel and queue.check provides a processing barrier, not a broker settlement receipt. Headers are JSON field tables preserving binary/int64/timestamp tags, null and falsy values. Uint64 uses decimal text. Sources: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/amqp-0-9-1-reference https://amqp-node.github.io/amqplib/channel_api.html https://github.com/amqp-node/amqplib/tree/v2.2.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
